text:
sara: Quick follow-up from the postmortem. I'm assembling an action tracker for the recurring KV-cache OOMs. Please ack ownership by EOD.

mike: ack. I'll run lightweight alloc-sampler every 6h and push artifacts to S3. Cron: 
`0 */6 * * * /opt/bin/alloc-sampler --scope=kv --dur=600 --out=s3://redwood-telemetry/kv-samples/2969999999/`

anisha: I'll own the fragmentation experiments (slab targets + compacting). Test matrix: slab_target=[0.55,0.65], compact=[true,false]. Will post results in 48h.

ben: infra will spin a mirrored staging env with high residency profile. ETA 2h. Canary will be 10% traffic, 20m watch.

elaine: creating a daily digest template: fields: run_id, peak_rss, slab_frag_ratio, top_alloc_sites, repro_steps, PRs, owner, status. First digest 08:00 UTC tomorrow.

jules: repro steps: call /v1/generate with context=20k, 6 concurrent workers; observe steady RSS rise ~5-7m.

sara: owners summary (48h loop): mike sampler; anisha experiments; ben infra; elaine digest; dev owners paste repros here.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary (staging) at 2026-05-20T09:00:00Z. Auto-rollback enabled.

sara: we'll reconvene after first digest. Aim to convert effective fixes into platform guardrails (softlimits + alerts).
